usage: Discovery only. Fetch record_url and compare the complete scope, findings, limitations and review before claiming an idea was tested. No match means no matching documented record here, not proof that an idea is new.

records.title: LP2-00–55: direct polynomial streams, degree at most eight
records.question: Can a fixed-modulus integer polynomial of degree at most eight directly generate each page, in index or prime coordinates?
records.summary: All 880 page/representation/degree checks have difference gcd 1, excluding this direct-output model for every modulus greater than one. Polynomial keys mixed with plaintext are not tested.
